company.name: NinjaOne
company.shortDescription: NinjaOne serves as an IT platform for endpoint management that enhances productivity, minimizes risks, and lowers overall IT expenses.
company.description: NinjaOne automates the hardest parts of IT, empowering IT teams with visibility, security, and control over all endpoints. The NinjaOne platform is proven to increase productivity while reducing risk and IT costs. The NinjaOne platform caters to various use cases and stands out as the highest-rated software on G2 in seven categories, encompassing endpoint management, RMM, and patch management. Additionally, NinjaOne provides features such as endpoint backup, multi-tenant MSP backup, streamlined remote support through one-click control, and seamless integration with numerous IT and security technologies.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based IT operations platform that combines endpoint management, monitoring, automation, security, backup, remote access, and service workflows in a centralized console.
productsAndServices.name: NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform

productsAndServices.description: A centralized endpoint management system for discovering, inventorying, configuring, monitoring, and automating tasks across organizational devices.
productsAndServices.name: NinjaOne Endpoint Management

productsAndServices.description: An RMM service that monitors Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, generates alerts, inventories devices, and enables remote troubleshooting and automation.
productsAndServices.name: NinjaOne Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM)

productsAndServices.description: An automated patching service that identifies and deploys operating-system and third-party application updates, with risk analysis to support safer remediation.
productsAndServices.name: NinjaOne Autonomous Patch Management

productsAndServices.description: A backup and recovery service for endpoints and servers that protects device data and supports restoration from a centralized cloud console.
productsAndServices.name: NinjaOne Backup

productsAndServices.description: A remote access tool for connecting to and controlling Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints from the NinjaOne console.
productsAndServices.name: NinjaOne Remote Control
